cohort: Postpartum mothers with severe preeclampsia already on oral labetalol treatment, admitted and delivered in the department of OG in GDMCH.
finding: Treatment with labetalol and furosemide significantly reduced systolic blood pressure and complications, including acute pulmonary edema, compared to labetalol alone in postpartum mothers with severe preeclampsia.
gest_age: Varied, with 49.17% between 28-37 weeks, 36.67% above 37 weeks, and 14.16% less than 28 weeks.
